title: Customer Decision Respond Journal
description: CD-08: the write-ahead record of one customer-decision respond run, written before the ledger append and removed once every step is done. Stored at <case dir>/respond-journal/<receipt_id>.json. A run that stopped part way (a throw, the customer room's time limit) is completed from it on the next respond, confirm, submit or status of the case: the receipt (with its decision ids pre-assigned), the audit entry, the switches (from the effective decisions before the write) and the brief input. See libs/core/customer-decision/store.ts and scripts/customer_decision.ts.

stage.description: The last step known to be done: planned (nothing written yet), ledger_written, receipt_written, audited.

receipt.description: The receipt this run writes (validated against customer-decision-receipt.schema.json on its own).

before.description: The agenda's effective decisions before the ledger write (switch detection).
